app.read.failed: Couldn't read notes: {reason}. Press F5 to reload

draft.restore.elsewhere: You have an unfinished note: return to “{name}” to continue

settings.hotkey.needsCommand: A shortcut needs ⌘ or ⌃. Without one it would interfere with typing and selecting text in every app.
settings.skipDirs.desc: Folders with exactly these names are not listed (case-insensitive). Folders starting with . or marked hidden are always skipped.
settings.skipDirs.noPath: Enter a folder name only, without a path (for example node_modules)
settings.shell.notApplied: Not changed: Windows refused the change, so the switch was restored. Details are in the log.

settings.reset.desc: Resets the interface settings on the General, Annotations, Copying and Advanced pages, and sets the language back to the system language. Screen capture, tray and startup, system integration, the library and window position are not affected.
settings.reset.title: Restore default settings?
settings.reset.body: The interface settings on the General, Annotations, Copying and Advanced pages will be reset, and the language set back to the system language. Screen capture, tray and startup, system integration, the library and window position are not affected.

app.snapshot.empty: The image is too large to create a snapshot with the available memory

stage.mediaError.image.body: The file may be damaged, still being written, or not a valid image. This view refreshes automatically once the file is fixed.
stage.mediaError.video.title: Can't play this video

stage.mediaError.video.broken: The file may be damaged or still being written. This view refreshes automatically once the file is fixed.
stage.mediaError.longPath: The path is longer than 260 characters, and such paths can't be read from a network location. Use fewer folder levels or shorter names, or copy the item to this computer before annotating.

stage.mediaError.hevc: This HEIC / HEIF image also needs the HEVC Video Extensions. If they're already installed, the file may be damaged.

library.note.skippedTitle: Change this in Settings → Advanced → Skipped folders
library.note.moreOffTitle: Turn this on in Settings → Advanced → More formats

app.copy.asImages.hint: For web-based AI and chat apps

library.offline: Its drive isn't connected. Connect the USB drive, external disk or network drive
welcome.title: Mark what needs to change and let AI make the changes
welcome.lead: Annotate images and videos made by Claude Code or Codex, pointing out exactly where and what to change
welcome.step1.title: Add items
welcome.step1.body: Drag images, videos or folders anywhere into the window
welcome.step2.title: Annotate
welcome.step2.body: Drag on the canvas to draw a rectangle, or use the pin, pen or arrow, then describe the change
welcome.step3.title: Copy the notes
welcome.step3.body: Use Copy as Text and paste into Claude Code or Codex; for web-based AI and chat apps, use Copy as Images
welcome.saved: Notes are saved automatically to the project's .sniptoss folder, where Claude Code and Codex working in that project can read them.
welcome.capture: Something other than a file? Press {keys} to capture part of the screen, annotate it, then paste it into an AI tool.
welcome.captureNoKey: Something other than a file? Click Capture in the title bar to capture part of the screen, annotate it, then paste it into an AI tool.
tour.tools.title: Mark what to change
tour.tools.body: Use the rectangle, pin, pen or arrow to mark the spot that needs changing, then describe the change. For feedback that isn't about one spot, use Overall.
tour.panel.title: Notes panel
tour.panel.body: Notes are listed here by number, matching the marks on the canvas. When you're done, copy them from the bottom of the panel and hand them to AI.
tour.capture.title: Capture
tour.capture.body: Something other than a file? Press {keys} to capture part of the screen, annotate it, then paste it into an AI tool.
tour.capture.bodyNoKey: Something other than a file? Click here to capture part of the screen, annotate it, then paste it into an AI tool.
tour.skipTitle: Close the tour. You can take it again from Help → Feature Tour
hint.copy: When your notes are ready, use Copy as Text and paste into Claude Code or Codex; for web-based AI and chat apps, use Copy as Images.
hint.video: Marks on a video apply only to the current frame, so pause on the frame that needs changing before you mark it. For feedback about a moment rather than a spot, use Timestamped (T).
library.empty.title: No items yet
library.empty.body: Added items are grouped into projects by folder. Removing them from the list doesn't delete files.
settings.ai.desc: Notes are saved to the .sniptoss folder of the item's project as you write them. Copy as Text copies each note's text and position, plus the local paths of the item and its snapshots; use it with AI that can read files on this computer, such as Claude Code and Codex. Web-based AI can't read local files, so use Copy as Images: it creates one image per note and also works in chat apps.
settings.ai.scope: What gets copied: the checked notes if any are checked; otherwise every open note listed in the notes panel. Right-clicking a note copies just that note; right-clicking the canvas copies the notes on the current item; right-clicking a row in the library copies that row (a project copies the whole project, a folder everything in it).
panel.search.title: Search note text and replies (Ctrl F); separate words with spaces. Enter selects the first match, ↓ moves into the list, Esc clears. While filtering, Select all and the copy buttons apply only to matches
panel.search.inResolved: {count, plural, one {# resolved note matches} other {# resolved notes match}}
shortcuts.findNotes: Find notes (moves focus to the notes search box; searches text and replies)
app.error.clipboardFocus: The clipboard can't be accessed while the window is in the background. Click the window and try copying again
app.error.clipboardBusy: The clipboard is in use by another program (such as Remote Desktop or a clipboard tool). Try again shortly
app.error.clipboard: Couldn't write to the clipboard. Try again shortly; details are in the log

app.color.doneMany: Changed the color of {count, plural, one {# mark} other {# marks}}

menu.help.introTitle: The basics: add items, annotate, copy the notes
menu.help.tourTitle: Walks through the drawing tools, the notes panel and Capture
menu.help.logsTitle: Logs record runtime errors and help with troubleshooting
menu.help.diagnosticsTitle: Copies version, system and runtime info to attach to a bug report (no file paths)
menu.help.reportTitle: Opens GitHub Issues in the browser with diagnostic info filled in
help.intro.title: Getting Started
settings.title: Settings
settings.general.title: General
settings.general.uiScaleDesc: Scales text and controls. The items themselves are not affected.
settings.general.backdropDesc: What fills the space around an item that doesn't fill the canvas. Choose Solid when judging color.
settings.general.tray: Keep running in the tray when the window is closed
settings.general.trayDesc: The app keeps running in the background so the capture shortcut stays available. To quit, choose Exit from the tray menu.
settings.general.autostart: Start when signing in to Windows
settings.general.autostartDesc: Starts in the tray without opening a window.
settings.general.initialOpen: The first item with open notes
settings.general.storageDesc: Notes are saved in the .sniptoss folder of the item's project and move with it. AI agents working in that project can read them directly.
settings.general.storageMissing: This project has no notes yet, so the .sniptoss folder doesn't exist
settings.annotate.title: Annotations
settings.annotate.categoryDesc: Used for the first note on each item; later notes start with the previous note's category. Press Alt 1⁠–⁠4 to switch while typing.
settings.annotate.autoCompose: Open the note box after drawing a mark
settings.annotate.autoComposeDesc: When off, press Enter or click the draft in the notes panel to start typing.
settings.annotate.pause: Pause video when choosing an annotation tool
settings.annotate.pauseDesc: Pressing C, R, B, A or N during playback pauses on the current frame.
settings.annotate.loopDesc: Plays again from the start when it reaches the end. You can also toggle it with the button on the playback bar or Ctrl L.
settings.annotate.showResolved: Show resolved notes on the canvas
settings.annotate.showResolvedDesc: Done and won't-fix notes are shown dimmed for reference.
settings.annotate.colorDesc: Default color of marks on the canvas and in snapshots. To change a single mark's color, click the mark on the canvas and choose a color, press 1–6, or right-click it. Pick a color that contrasts with the item.
settings.capture.desc: Select any area of the screen, draw marks and write notes. When you finish, the image is copied to the clipboard, ready to paste into an AI tool or a chat app. Start it from the Capture button in the title bar, the File menu, or the tray icon.
settings.capture.hotkeyDesc: Works in any app. Click the box, then press the new key combination. Esc or clicking elsewhere cancels; Backspace clears it.
settings.capture.hotkeyConflict: A global shortcut stops the same shortcut from working in other apps. If a key stops working somewhere, choose a different combination.
settings.capture.hotkeyTypes: {keys} types “{typed}” on this computer's keyboard layout. While it is the capture shortcut, that character can't be typed.
settings.capture.hide: Hide this window when starting a capture from it
settings.capture.hideDesc: Keeps this window out of the capture. When you start with the shortcut, the screen is captured as it is.
settings.capture.notesDesc: Adds a numbered list of your notes below the image. When off, the notes go to the clipboard as text instead, but apps such as Claude Code and Codex only take the image when pasting, so the notes may be lost.
settings.capture.folderMissing: The capture folder hasn't been created yet
settings.capture.accessOff: macOS hasn't allowed {app} to record the screen, so captures can't start. Allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security, then quit {app} and open it again.
settings.capture.accessOn: Allowed. macOS may ask again from time to time; choose Allow to keep capturing.
settings.hotkey.title: Click to record a new shortcut
settings.hotkey.recordingTitle: Press the new key combination (Esc or click elsewhere to cancel)
settings.ai.title: Copying
settings.ai.extraDesc: Appended to everything you copy, for example “Re-export after the changes and add _v2 to the file name”.
settings.system.title: System
settings.system.desc: These settings are stored in Windows for the current user only and are removed completely when turned off.
settings.system.shellDesc: Adds “Open with {app}” when right-clicking folders, images and videos. On Windows 11 it's under “Show more options”.
settings.system.shellAdded: Added to the File Explorer context menu
settings.system.shellRemoved: Removed from the File Explorer context menu
settings.system.dropDesc: Drag files or folders onto the desktop shortcut to open them. No setup needed.
settings.keys.title: Shortcuts
settings.keys.desc: Press ? at any time to see this list. Custom shortcuts are not supported yet.
settings.advanced.title: Advanced
settings.advanced.desc: You rarely need to change these.
settings.advanced.author: Author name
settings.advanced.authorDesc: Written to the author field of the notes file. Leave empty to use your Windows user name{name}.
settings.advanced.holdDesc: While holding C, R, B or A, use that tool temporarily; releasing returns to Select and keeps any unfinished note. When off, a single press switches tools and stays.
settings.advanced.listDesc: Which files in added folders are listed. Files added individually are not affected.
settings.advanced.kind.moreDesc: {exts}. When on, the File Explorer context menu covers these formats too.
settings.advanced.skipPlaceholder: Type a name and press Enter
settings.advanced.reviewDesc: By default only open notes are listed. When on, done and won't-fix notes are listed at the end for reference.
settings.advanced.shotSizeDesc: Longest side of each note's snapshot (saved in {dir}). Larger sizes are sharper but produce larger files.
settings.advanced.shotFormatDesc: PNG is lossless; JPEG is much smaller and suits photos and video.
settings.about.title: About
settings.about.shellMismatch: The app version is {version}, which doesn't match the interface. Reinstall to fix this
settings.about.author: Author
settings.about.feedbackDesc: Please attach diagnostic info when reporting an issue. It contains only versions and the runtime environment, no file paths or personal information.
shortcuts.done: Mark as done; press again to reopen (applies to the checked notes when any are checked)
shortcuts.wontfix: Mark as won't fix; press again to reopen
sc.notes.color: Change mark color (applies to the checked notes if any are checked; if you clicked one of a note's several marks on the canvas, only that mark changes)
menu.file.pasteTitle: Add the image on the clipboard (for example, one copied from web-based AI or a chat app), or files and folders copied in File Explorer
menu.file.revealCurrent: Show Current Item in File Explorer
menu.file.clearTitle: Pinned projects are kept. No files or notes are deleted.
menu.edit.copyChecked: Copy {count, plural, one {# Checked Note} other {# Checked Notes}} as Text
menu.edit.copyCheckedImages: Copy {count, plural, one {# Checked Note} other {# Checked Notes}} as Images
menu.edit.deleteChecked: Delete {count, plural, one {# Checked Note} other {# Checked Notes}}
menu.edit.deleteAllTitle: Deletes every note listed in the notes panel. Notes that aren't listed (resolved notes that are hidden, or notes that are filtered out, collapsed or missing from the search results) are kept.
menu.view.resetLayoutTitle: Restores the default window size, position and panel widths
menu.view.libraryPending: Library: Show Only Items with Open Notes
tool.select.tip: Select: click a note to select it; drag a mark to move or resize it; drag on empty space to draw a rectangle
tool.hand.tip: Hand: drag to pan. Hold H to use it temporarily; release to return to the previous tool
tool.point.tip: Pin: click to place a mark
tool.rect.tip: Rectangle: drag to mark an area
tool.arrow.tip: Arrow: drag to point at something
menu.note.wholeTitle: A note about the whole item, without a position
menu.note.timedTitle: A note about the current video frame, without a position (can be changed to a range)
menu.note.folderTitle: A note about every item in the folder, including subfolders
menu.note.colorChecked: Mark Color of {count, plural, one {# Checked Note} other {# Checked Notes}}
menu.window.topmostTitle: Keeps this window above other windows, handy beside an AI window
header.wholeTip: Overall comment: about the whole item, without a position
header.timedTip: Timestamped comment: about the current video frame, without a position
header.toggleRight: {open, select, yes {Hide} other {Show}} notes panel (Ctrl Alt B)
sc.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
sc.menus: Open a menu (or press Alt or F10, then the letter; ↑↓ to choose, Home End for the first or last item, ←→ to switch, Enter or Space to run, Esc to close)
sc.capture.start: Start a screen capture (default shortcut; can be changed in Settings)
sc.capture.select: Select the window under the pointer / drag an area (arrow keys nudge it; hold Shift to nudge by 10 pixels)
sc.capture.draw: Rectangle / ellipse / arrow / pen (write a note after drawing; Esc skips it)
sc.capture.notes: Pin / overall comment (Alt 1⁠–⁠4 switches category in the note box; Shift Enter for a new line)
sc.capture.color: Change color (click a mark on the image to select it and change only that mark; otherwise it applies to the marks you draw next)
sc.capture.done: Finish and copy the image (notes go below it; Ctrl C or double-clicking the selection also works; Ctrl Z undoes the last step)
sc.list.step: Previous / next row (Home / End jump to the first / last row)
sc.list.range: Extend the selection (or Shift-click; Ctrl-click adds or removes)
sc.list.clear: Clear the selection (or click empty space in the list)
sc.list.expand: Expand / collapse projects and folders (on an item row: step frames or switch items)
sc.list.open: Open an item, or expand / collapse a project or folder (Space on the current item plays / pauses)
sc.list.copy: Copy the notes of the selected projects, folders or items as text
sc.list.remove: Remove from the list (files are not deleted)
sc.list.menu: Open the menu for the current row (or press the Menu key)
sc.notes.holdHand: Use the hand temporarily; releasing returns to the previous tool
sc.notes.holdTools: Hold to switch tools: use that tool temporarily, releasing returns to Select (turn on in Settings → Advanced)
sc.notes.timed: Timestamped comment (about the current video frame, without a position)
sc.notes.folder: Folder comment (about every item in its folder; for other folders, right-click them in the library)
sc.notes.save: Save the note being written (Shift Enter for a new line; Ctrl Enter also works when focus is outside the note box; after drawing a mark, Enter starts typing)
sc.notes.undoPlace: With several marks: remove the most recent one (while the note box is open, marks you draw belong to the same note)
sc.notes.check: Check / uncheck the selected note (copying and status changes apply to checked notes)
sc.notes.copy: Copy notes as text (for Claude Code and Codex; the checked notes if any, otherwise every open note listed in the notes panel)
sc.notes.copyImages: Copy notes as images (one per note, for web-based AI and chat apps)
sc.notes.nudge: Nudge the selected mark by 1 pixel (hold Shift for 10 pixels)
sc.notes.editDelete: Edit / delete the selected note; deletes the checked notes when any are checked (Backspace also deletes)
sc.paste: Add from the clipboard: a copied image or files
sc.notes.undo: Undo (Ctrl Shift Z or Ctrl Y to redo)
sc.notes.cancel: Cancel / return to the Select tool
sc.canvas.fill: Fill the window (drag to see the rest)
sc.canvas.marks: Show / hide the marks on the canvas (the selected note's mark still shows)
sc.canvas.pan: Pan (or drag while holding H, or use the Hand tool)
sc.video.range: While writing a note: make it cover a time range (set start / end; I / O alone work when not typing)
app.save.busyLoop: The notes file keeps being changed by another program, so this change wasn't saved
app.add.exists: Already in the list; it has been selected
app.paste.empty: There's no image or file on the clipboard
app.paste.image: Added the image from the clipboard to Pasted Images
app.capture.hideOn: Starting a capture from this window will hide it first
app.capture.hideOff: Starting a capture from this window will no longer hide it
app.window.topmostOn: Always on top is on. Turn it off from the Window menu
markColor.name: {color, select, orange {Orange} red {Red} yellow {Yellow} green {Green} blue {Blue} other {Purple}}
markColor.title: Changes only how the mark is drawn (canvas, snapshots, images), not the note. Pick the default color to follow Settings.
panel.draft: Mark drawn. Click here or press Enter to write the note
ask.keep: No files or notes are deleted.
ask.delete.title: Delete this note?
ask.delete.undo: You can undo this with Ctrl Z.

cli.help:
sniptoss: read and update the notes in a project's .sniptoss folder, for AI agents. Notes are created in {app}.

Usage: sniptoss COMMAND [OPTIONS]

Commands:
  list                List notes (only open ones by default)
  review              Regenerate .sniptoss/REVIEW.md
  resolve ID          Mark a note as done; -m says what was changed
  wontfix ID          Mark a note as won't fix; -m says why

Options:
  --root DIR          Project folder (default: the current folder; looks upward for the nearest folder with .sniptoss, like git)
  --all               With list: include resolved notes
  --json              With list: print JSON
  -m, --message TEXT  Reply for resolve / wontfix
  --author NAME       Reply author (default: agent)
  -h, --help          Show this help
  -v, --version       Show the version
